questions.q: Why is a CRM Analytics dashboard with many widgets often slow to load?
options: Each widget is backed by a query, and the page waits for them to run
Widgets are stored as image files that are large
Dashboards always refresh their datasets on open
The browser can only display ten widgets at a time
questions.explain: Every chart, number, and table is powered by a step, which is a query. More queries mean more work before the dashboard is ready.

questions.q: What should you do before changing a slow dashboard?
options: Delete half of the widgets to see what happens
Measure it with the Dashboard Inspector to find the actual bottlenecks
Rebuild it from a template
Move it to a private app
questions.explain: The Dashboard Inspector collects performance metrics and flags issues such as redundant or slow queries. Measure first so you fix the real problem.

questions.q: Where does Salesforce guidance suggest doing calculations to help performance?
options: In each dashboard query, on every load
In the viewer's browser
At the dataset level, in the dataflow or recipe
In a native report, then copy the numbers
questions.explain: A derived field computed once during data preparation costs nothing at view time, while the same calculation repeated in dashboard queries costs time on every load.

questions.q: Why are global filters generally preferred over selection-based filters for whole-dashboard filtering?
options: They are required for faceting to work
They change the dataset's schema permanently
They hide widgets from viewers without access
They narrow the data before queries run and avoid extra steps
questions.explain: A global filter reduces the data first, so each query works against a smaller set. Selection-based filters can add extra queries.

questions.q: A dashboard has several pages. How should you run the Dashboard Inspector?
options: Only on the last page
Once, on any layout, since all pages share the same queries
On every layout and page, because each can contain different queries
Never; it works only for lenses
questions.explain: Different layouts and pages can contain different widgets and queries, so each needs its own measurement.
